title: Weekend days are charged as leave
summary: The length of a request counts calendar days instead of working days. A Friday-to-Monday request is charged as 4 days instead of 2, so employees lose leave they never take.
steps: Request leave from Friday 8 March 2030 to Monday 11 March 2030.
Look at the Days column in My requests: it says 4.

expected.text: Only Monday to Friday count. By hand: Friday 8 + Monday 11 March 2030 = 2 working days.

actual: The request is stored with days = 4.

how.state: SELECT days FROM requests WHERE id = <id> → 4
how.byDesignCheck: PRD R2 gives this exact example: 2 working days.

hint: Make countDays walk from start to end and count only days whose UTC weekday is Monday to Friday.
